# Institute For Functional Dentistry

> A comprehensive oral-systemic education platform offering functional dentistry certification programs that integrate whole-body health principles with dental practice.

The Institute for Functional Dentistry (IFD) provides systems-based dental education and certification pathways for dental professionals seeking to bridge the gap between traditional dentistry and functional medicine. The organization emphasizes the interconnection between oral health and systemic wellness, offering multiple certification tracks for dental teams, hygienists, and practitioners.

## Key Topics

- Functional Dentistry
- Oral-Systemic Health
- Functional Medicine
- Systems Biology
- Certification Programs
- Dental Education

## Certification Programs & Curriculum

- [Functional Dentistry Certification Curriculum](https://functionaldentistry.org/our-certification-programs-curriculum): Overview of IFD certification pathways bridging dental and whole-body health
- [Functional Dental Team Certification](https://functionaldentistry.org/our-certification-programs-curriculum/functional-dental-team-certification): Track 1 entry-level certification for dental teams and assistants
- [Functional Hygiene Certificate – IFD Training](https://functionaldentistry.org/functional-hygiene-certificate-track-2): Track 2 hygiene certification for preventive whole-body-linked dental care
- [Core Functional Dentistry Certification](https://functionaldentistry.org/our-certification-programs-curriculum/core-functional-dentistry-certification): Track 3 foundational certification in oral-systemic science for practitioners
